Headline: Brown Line Delays
ShortDescription: Brown Line trains are running w/residual delays following earlier fire department activity at Western. Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Brown Line trains are running w/residual delays following earlier fire department activity at Western.

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Westbound #21 Cermak buses are temporarily rerouted via Cermak, Archer, Canal, Cermak and over normal route: due to a street blockage near Cermak/Archer.
